From: wind...@world.net (Gary Morton)
Subject: Re: QUESTION ON MASK OF 1000 FACES

In <3hqfgn$4...@uwm.edu>, scy...@alpha2.csd.uwm.edu (John Wade Kim) writes:
>If I use Bleed you with legal Manipulations, and Mask of 1000 to another vampire with say only ofuscate, can He still use the legal Manipulations, and who pays for it...etc..
>thanks
>scy...@alpha2.csd.uwm.edu

I believe the easiest answer to this would be...
1 Announce bleed. (holding ever-so-nasty additional bleed card secretly in hand)
2 Opponent announces block with a real stinker of a vamp (DOH!)
3 Play 'Mask' ( Oh well, better make the most of it...)

If opponent does not block, play all the nasties ya got :)

Have a good one.
Yes that's the easy answer, but I want to know the not so easy answer.
Because, if you want to use Mask of 1000 Faces for the stealth but you want to bleed using Govern the unaligned or Legal Manipulations, then you have to declare the action with one vampire and change it to another. But if the first vampire doesn't have presences or dominate you are stuck.
So I need how you can play Mask of 1000 faces.
thanks
scy...@alpha2.csd.uwm.edu

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
The short answer: an action is only paid for when it remains unblocked.
So it would be paid for by the Vampire who actually got through (the
one useing the Mask1000(tm)).

>From Tom's errata list (available by ftp)
>Mask of 1000 Faces:
> The new vampire takes over the action completely, even if it could not
> legally perform that action normally. Any action modifiers remain in
> full effect, even if the new vampire could not legally use those modifiers.

>Brian
